_comment: 來賓端老師卡片與 /lab/<房號> 介紹頁。color 是這一間在全站的顏色（來賓端卡片、後台選頁區塊與行程、動線表都用同一色，五間各一色，改這裡就全站跟著改）。303 只列陳惠美（明確指示，與母簡報不同）。**`one_line_source` 標成 lead 的那一句是老師自己簡報上的原文，逐字照用，不改寫**（明確指示；目前 302、303 有）。intro／expertise／equipment／background／papers 是草稿：302 與 303 取自老師自己的簡報，其餘由母簡報與公開資料（系網站、國科會獲獎頁、期刊）整理；查不到的一律留空，沒有憑據的學歷、職稱、論文不寫。confirmed=false 表示尚待老師本人確認（待確認事項 1），後台「設定」分頁可以直接改。photo 為 null 時頁面顯示姓名縮寫；photo／photos[].src 是 assets/… 的站台檔、labs/… 的媒體庫 key，或 https 網址。302、303、305 的照片取自老師自己的簡報／一頁 CV（圖說也是他們原本的標法，照抄；305 那幾張只有英文圖說，沒有中文就留空，頁面自己退回英文，不要自己翻）。

labs.name_ja: 健康景観インテリジェンス室

lead.title_zh: 特聘教授 · 中心主任

labs.one_line_en: Physiological and psychological responses to landscapes, captured in real settings with a seven-workstation measurement array and the in-house HealthCloud platform.
labs.one_line_zh: 以七站量測陣列與自建的 HealthCloud 平台，在真實場域擷取人對景觀的生理與心理反應。
labs.intro_en: The laboratory asks what a landscape does to the body, and answers it with measurement rather than preference surveys. A seven-workstation tool chain takes a participant from screening through physiological recording to data reduction, and the readings are pooled on HealthCloud, the laboratory's own platform. The approach brings neuroscience, wearable sensing and artificial intelligence together, and the evidence it produces is what HEALS Design — the laboratory's own design framework — is built on.
labs.intro_zh: 這一間問的是「景觀對身體做了什麼」，並且用量測而不是偏好問卷來回答。七站工具鏈把受試者從篩選、生理記錄一路帶到資料整理，讀數彙整到研究室自建的 HealthCloud 平台。作法上整合腦神經科學、穿戴式感測與人工智慧，而這些證據正是研究室自己那一套 HEALS Design 設計架構的基礎。
expertise_zh: 景觀神經科學（fMRI、穿戴式感測）
equipment_zh: 七站心理生理量測陣列
labs.background_en: Ph.D. in Recreation and Parks, Pennsylvania State University (1993). M.S. in Horticulture, National Taiwan University (1987). Professor at NTU's Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture since 2005; Director of the Green Health Research Center from August 2026. Adjunct Professor, Department of Landscape Architecture, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, since 2017. Recipient of the NSTC Outstanding Research Award (2025). The first landscape scholar to measure how landscapes affect brain activity using functional magnetic resonance imaging.
labs.background_zh: 美國賓州州立大學遊憩與公園學博士（1993）、國立臺灣大學園藝學碩士（1987）。2005 年起任教臺大園藝暨景觀學系，2026 年 8 月起兼綠色健康研究中心主任；2017 年起兼任美國伊利諾大學香檳分校景觀建築系兼任教授。2025 年獲國科會傑出研究獎。是全球第一位以功能性磁振造影（fMRI）量測景觀如何影響腦部活動的景觀學者。

papers.title: Using functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) to analyze brain region activity when viewing landscapes
Landscapes and Human Health
papers.venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health, 2017

labs.one_line_en: Our research focuses on urban microclimate, green infrastructure, and human thermal comfort, integrating field measurements, numerical simulation, and spatial analysis to develop climate-responsive planning and design strategies.
labs.one_line_zh: 本研究室聚焦都市微氣候、綠色基盤與人體熱舒適，整合現地量測、數值模擬與空間分析，發展氣候調適之規劃與設計策略。
labs.intro_en: The laboratory runs a full ENVI-met microclimate workflow — database preparation, model building, simulation, conversion to human thermal comfort indices, and visualisation of the results — calibrated against its own on-site sensing. The output is applied to two kinds of question: how a park should be laid out, and how green infrastructure performs when read at three different scales. Thermal comfort and wind-field evidence is turned into layouts that can actually be built.
labs.intro_zh: 研究室有一整套 ENVI-met 微氣候模擬流程——資料庫建置、模型建置、軟體模擬、人體熱舒適度換算、成果圖像化——並以自己的現地感測校正。成果用在兩類問題上：公園該怎麼配置，以及綠色基盤在三個不同尺度下的表現如何。熱舒適與風場的證據，最後變成蓋得出來的配置方案。
expertise_en: Green space systems and green infrastructure
Green roof design and benefit assessment
expertise_zh: 生態系服務評估與製圖
綠屋頂設計與效益評估
labs.background_en: Ph.D. in Agriculture, Department of Horticulture, National Taiwan University. Associate Professor at NTU's Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture from 2017 to 2023, Professor since August 2023. Leads the Greenlands Ecosystem Services Lab (GES Lab).
labs.background_zh: 國立臺灣大學園藝學系農學博士。2017 至 2023 年任臺大園藝暨景觀學系副教授，2023 年 8 月起任教授。主持 GES Lab（Greenlands Ecosystem Services Lab，綠地生態系服務研究室）。

papers.title: The plant and faunal species composition and diversity on rooftop farms: Seasonal variation and the effects of site and surrounding characteristics

labs.name_ja: 景観環境シミュレーション室

lead.title_en: Distinguished Professor · Department Chair · Co-PI, GHRC
lead.title_zh: 特聘教授 · 系主任 · 中心 Co-PI

labs.one_line_en: Grounded in evidence-based design, the lab integrates scientific theory and landscape aesthetics to develop virtual nature-based healing environments and experiential products that address diverse health needs.
labs.one_line_zh: 以實證設計為基礎，融合科學理論與景觀美學，開發回應不同健康需求的虛擬自然療癒環境與體驗產品。
labs.intro_en: Immersive virtual reality is used here to test whether a designed environment really changes what people perceive and feel — work that has reached as far as wound pain. Eye tracking and EEG supply the evidence. Alongside the experiments the laboratory builds a 360-degree VR library for environmental education and for food-and-farming education, so the same virtual environments are also teaching material. Research outcomes cover patient care, older adults and schoolchildren, and green care in the rural north of Taiwan.
labs.intro_zh: 這一間用沉浸式虛擬實境檢驗設計過的環境是不是真的改變了人的知覺與感受——做到過傷口疼痛這麼具體的題目；證據來自眼動與腦波。實驗之外，研究室也建置 360 度環景 VR 教材庫，用於環境教育與食農教育，同一批虛擬環境因此也是教材。研究成果涵蓋病患照護、高齡與學童，以及北區農村的綠色照顧。
expertise_en: Landscape and recreation planning and design
Horticultural therapy and therapeutic landscape design
Psychology and behaviour in landscape and recreation
expertise_zh: 園藝治療與療癒景觀設計
equipment_zh: 360 度環景 VR 教材庫
labs.background_en: Ph.D., Department of Horticulture, National Taiwan University. Distinguished Professor and Chair of NTU's Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture; Director of the NTU Meifeng Highland Experimental Farm. Co-PI of the Green Health Research Center, and its Director before August 2026.
labs.background_zh: 國立臺灣大學園藝學系博士。現任臺大園藝暨景觀學系特聘教授兼系主任，並兼臺大山地實驗農場（梅峰）場長。綠色健康研究中心 Co-PI，2026 年 8 月前為中心主任。

papers.title: Feasibility assessment and implementation strategies of green care in rural Taiwan

labs.name_ja: パノラマシネマ体験室
labs.one_line_en: A CAVE-style 360-degree cinema that moves validation from the single subject to the group, with the flagship super-slow-jogging programme for chronic low back pain.
labs.one_line_zh: CAVE 式 360 度全景影院，把驗證從單人推進到群體；旗艦案例為針對慢性下背痛的超慢跑介入。
labs.intro_en: A headset validates one person at a time. This room puts a whole group inside the same projected environment, which is what an intervention actually looks like when it is delivered. The flagship case pairs the CAVE with super-slow jogging for chronic low back pain, and the design groups participants by who the intervention is for. The wider research programme concerns urban green space, health, and leisure for older adults.
labs.intro_zh: 頭戴式裝置一次只驗證一個人。這一間讓一整群人同時進到同一個投影環境裡——介入措施真正在執行時就是這個樣子。旗艦案例把 CAVE 與超慢跑結合，處理慢性下背痛，並依介入對象分群設計。更大的研究主題是都市綠地、健康，以及高齡者的休閒。
expertise_en: Landscape and leisure planning and design for older adults
expertise_zh: 高齡者景觀與休閒規劃設計
equipment_zh: CAVE 式 360 度投影全景影院
labs.background_en: Ph.D., Department of Recreation, Park and Tourism Management, Pennsylvania State University. Associate Professor, Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture, National Taiwan University.
labs.background_zh: 美國賓州州立大學遊憩、公園與觀光管理學系博士。現任臺大園藝暨景觀學系副教授。

labs.name_zh: IVR 研究室（沉浸式虛擬實境）
labs.name_ja: IVR研究室（没入型バーチャルリアリティ）
labs.one_line_en: Focuses on the perception of and attachment to places and environments, and how these experiences shape landscape preferences, spatial behavior, and travel decisions.
labs.one_line_zh: 聚焦於地方與環境的感知、依附及其變化，並探討這些經驗如何形塑景觀偏好、空間行為與旅遊決策。
labs.intro_en: Four directions, all of them about place. Place attachment: how it changes, and how it transfers. Landscape and spatial perception: preference, facility colours, crowding, mystery. Nightscape and lighting: day-versus-night preference, prospect and refuge, the impression a lit place leaves. Travel and behaviour: virtual tours, visit intention, nostalgia, authenticity. Immersive virtual reality is the instrument rather than the showpiece — it lets a landscape be varied one element at a time, so the change in what people perceive can be read off.
labs.intro_zh: 四個方向，講的都是「地方」。地方依附：它怎麼變化、怎麼轉移。景觀與空間知覺：偏好、設施顏色、擁擠感、神秘感。夜間環境與照明：日夜偏好、展望與庇護、被照亮的地方留下什麼印象。旅遊與行為：虛擬導覽、造訪意願、懷舊、真實性。沉浸式虛擬實境在這裡是儀器而不是展示品——它讓景觀一次只改一個元素，人的知覺變化就讀得出來。
equipment_zh: 沉浸式虛擬實境（IVR）實驗設備
labs.background_en: Associate Professor, Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture, National Taiwan University. Vice President of the 21st board of the Chinese Institute of Landscape Architecture.
labs.background_zh: 現任臺大園藝暨景觀學系副教授。中華民國景觀學會第 21 屆副理事長。
